entries.german: Erzbischof P[eter] gestattet dem Ritter Arnold von Uissigheim (uessink-) seine Mainzer Lehengüter zu Hildbrandzellen (Hiltwarisselden)1 an das Kloster Bronnbach (Brune-). ord. Cist. gegen eine Hufe in der Gemarkung des Dorfes Uissigheim zu vertauschen, die er von Mainz zu Lehen nimmt.
entries.english: Archbishop Peter allowed Arnold von Uissigheim, Ritter, to exchange his Mainz fiefdoms at Hildbrandzellen to the Bronnbach Monastery ord. Cist. for a Hufe in the district of the village of Uissigheim, which he took as a fief from Mainz.

facts.content: exchanged his Hildbrandzellen fiefs with Bronnbach Abbey for a Hube in the district of Uissigheim, which he took as a fief from Mainz.
approved Arnold von Uissigheim’s exchange of fiefs.
